title: Seo Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the SEO Manager role at Outliant . Outliant is a fully remote, US-based digital product development and startup consulting company, proudly acquired by Ignite Visibility. We specialize in bringing visionary ideas to life through intuitive, high-performing digital products. Our globally diverse team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and pushing boundaries. Now, as part of Ignite Visibility, we are expanding our reach and capabilities while continuing to build exceptional digital experiences that make a real impact. We are looking for a talented international SEO Strategist (supervisory level of experience) to join our team full-time. This is a team lead supervisory role; you must be a senior SEO leader and able to work U.S. business time, Eastern Standard Time.

Seniority Level: Senior Level

Employment type: Full-time

Job function: Marketing and Sales

Industries: Software Development

Responsibilities

  • Provide SEO support to an SEO Strategist
  • Develop and manage content strategies tailored to each franchise
  • Oversee the implementation of linking strategies
  • Create and oversee organic search strategies for assigned clients
  • Provide detailed site analysis and technical recommendations to improve organic visibility
  • Assist with or create website SEO audits
  • Identify new link-building opportunities and develop relationships for link building
  • Assist with onboarding and implementation of new organic search clients
  • Develop and streamline organic search processes to improve campaign performance
  • Collaborate with account managers, project managers, and other departments to highlight the impact of organic search to clients
  • Work across departments to gain a strong understanding of organic SEO
  • Ensure on-time, on-budget SEO deliverables; identify and resolve potential impediments or escalate as necessary
  • Monitor and track campaign performance analytics based on client metrics
  • Review rankings and link data against internal success measurements
  • Review and help create monthly client reports, verify accuracy, and provide analysis
  • Support account managers with data acquisition and campaign insights for business reviews
  • Attend key account meetings as needed
  • Engage in ongoing professional development to stay current with digital marketing trends
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management, supporting SEO strategist colleagues

Qualifications

  • 4+ years SEO strategy and campaign implementation experience
  • Strong client relationship and English communication skills
  • Proficiency in managing multi-location and national SEO programs
  • Strategic planning and execution for franchise-specific challenges
  • Project management skills

Additional information

Ignite Visibility is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, disability, sex, age, ethnic or national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or presentation, pregnancy, genetics, veteran status, or any other status protected by state or federal law.

Important Notice: To ensure the legitimacy of job opportunities, we strongly recommend that you solely rely on positions posted here on our official website: outliant.com/careers. All our current job openings require video interviews conducted in either synchronous (via Google Meet) or asynchronous (via Willo) formats. Kindly refrain from accepting offers that appear suspicious. For any inquiries or concerns, feel free to reach out via email. We are committed to maintaining integrity in our hiring process.

title: Analista de IT Ops Pleno
description:
Overview

Já pensou em utilizar a tecnologia para proporcionar o avanço das melhores práticas da medicina e mais, ajudar a mudar o sistema de saúde no Brasil?

O nosso sonho é revolucionar o ambiente da saúde, tornando-a mais acessível, mais humana e simples, mas para isso, precisamos de pessoas que desafiem o status quo e pensem grande todos os dias.

Se você gosta de um ambiente com muita autonomia, de trabalhar em um ambiente que você possa se arriscar todos os dias e com as principais tecnologias do mercado, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Analista de IT Ops com foco em suporte e sustentação de aplicações, sua missão será garantir a estabilidade, performance e confiabilidade de nossas plataformas, atuando como a ponte essencial entre a operação e a engenharia. Você não será apenas um solucionador de problemas, mas um agente de melhoria contínua. Esperamos que você use sua expertise em software para investigar causas-raiz em um ambiente de microsserviços, desenvolver fixes, criar automações e implementar soluções com IA para otimizar nossos processos de suporte.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Atuar na gestão de incidentes: Investigar problemas em nossas aplicações e suas integrações, realizando diagnóstico, investigação da causa raiz e implementação da solução do problema (solução de contorno ou solução definitiva).
  • Análise de Logs: Utilizar ferramentas de observabilidade para troubleshooting de problemas em ambientes de nuvem (GCP).
  • Desenvolver e Implementar Correções (Fixes): Atuar diretamente no código para corrigir bugs e vulnerabilidades, utilizando Git/GitHub para versionamento e participando do ciclo de deploy em produção.
  • Criar e Manter Automações: Identificar oportunidades de automação em rotinas de suporte e processos manuais, contribuindo para a eficiência do time.
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, manuais de procedimento e artigos para a base de conhecimento.
  • Apoiar na sustentação de integrações com sistemas de parceiros e fornecedores, garantindo a fluidez dos nossos processos.
  • Explorar e Aplicar Soluções de IA: Pesquisar e implementar soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial para prever falhas, otimizar o atendimento e escalar nosso suporte de forma inteligente.
  • Garantir a Saúde dos Microsserviços: Monitorar a comunicação entre serviços, investigar falhas e garantir a resiliência da nossa arquitetura distribuída.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas, principalmente Engenharia e Produto: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de engenharia para comunicar os aprendizados do suporte e influenciar o roadmap de produtos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com suporte e sustentação de aplicações web, integrações e APIs (Rest e SOAP).
  • Experiência com linguagem de programação, preferencialmente Node.js.
  • Experiência em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais e linguagem SQL.
  • Experiência em analisar, identificar e corrigir problemas sistêmicos na causa raiz.
  • Experiência em codificar e implementar correções em produção, seguindo as melhores práticas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência em versionadores de código, preferencialmente GitHub.
  • Experiência com automações (scripts, bots, etc.) para otimizar processos.
  • Experiência com Cloud.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Plataform
  • Experiência com mensageria utilizando RabbitMQ.
  • Conhecimento prático em arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento / observabilidade, preferencialmente Grafana e OpenTelemetry (Otel).
  • Conhecimento prático na utilização de IA Generativa para otimizar processos do dia a dia.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users\' lives. We are expanding across the United States and Central/South America and are seeking exceptional talent to join our dynamic and diverse team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment where collaboration and high impact are valued.

Here’s What You’ll Get To Work On:

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Here’s the experience we’re looking for:

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Here’s what we’re looking for this role to achieve:

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Projetos para integrar o Escritório de Projetos Corporativos (PMO) , com atuação estratégica na estruturação, acompanhamento e governança de projetos do segmento de saúde , incluindo iniciativas de integração pós-M&A , implantação de modelos de gestão hospitalar e projetos de eficiência operacional .

Essa posição será responsável por conectar áreas corporativas, operacionais e assistenciais, garantindo entregas de alto impacto alinhadas à estratégia da companhia e à sustentabilidade dos negócios em expansão.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir o planejamento, execução e controle do portfólio de projetos estratégicos do grupo, com foco em iniciativas de expansão, integração e melhoria de performance das unidades de saúde.
  • Atuar diretamente nos projetos de M&A, desde a due diligence operacional até a integração de processos, indicadores e sistemas entre as unidades adquiridas.
  • Liderar e acompanhar projetos de gestão hospitalar, como implantação de novos modelos assistenciais, reorganização de fluxos, padronização de processos e melhoria de indicadores operacionais.
  • Estruturar cronogramas, planos de ação e status reports, assegurando a governança e visibilidade das entregas junto às diretorias envolvidas.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as áreas de negócio, tecnologia, controladoria e operação assistencial, garantindo alinhamento entre as frentes corporativas e locais.
  • Mapear riscos, dependências e impactos operacionais dos projetos, elaborando planos de mitigação e contingência.
  • Apoiar a construção de dashboards, indicadores e relatórios executivos para acompanhamento do portfólio de projetos de saúde.
  • Promover o uso de metodologias de gestão de projetos (ágeis, híbridas ou preditivas), assegurando o padrão de governança definido pelo PMO.
  • Contribuir na padronização de templates, processos e boas práticas de gestão de projetos, fortalecendo a maturidade organizacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Gestão Hospitalar, Economia, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de projetos no setor da saúde, preferencialmente em hospitais, operadoras de saúde, grupos médicos ou clínicas.
  • Vivência com projetos de integração pós-fusão (M&A) e/ou projetos de implantação de sistemas e processos hospitalares.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de indicadores assistenciais e operacionais, estrutura de custos hospitalares e fluxos de faturamento.
  • Domínio de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban, híbrido).
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos e processos (Jira, Project, Excel, Power BI, Bizagi ou similares).
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, pensamento sistêmico e forte senso de priorização.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de articulação com múltiplas áreas e níveis hierárquicos.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Saúde ou Governança Corporativa.
  • Certificações PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em implantação de sistemas hospitalares (ex: MV, Tasy, Benner, TOTVS Saúde).
  • Vivência em projetos de expansão regional, integração de unidades e centralização de processos corporativos.
  • Atuação anterior em PMO corporativo de grupos de saúde, operadoras ou hospitais de grande porte.

The Manager of Healthcare Partnerships will drive Medicare Advantage channel growth through continued development of relationships at Medicare Advantage (MA) Managed Care Plans. Strong relationships with partners, product or project teams, clinical and operational teams and field-based case managers will be critical for the Manager of Healthcare Partnerships success. This position will have a relationship-oriented approach to ensuring Mom’s Meals is recognized as an industry leader in quality, customer service, and nutritional support for vulnerable MA eligible members.

Targeted Salary Range: $90,000-100,000 plus bonus

Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to:

  • Effectively present Mom’s Meals products and services MA health plans and to a variety of audiences within those organizations, including clinical and operational leaders, case managers, social workers, physicians, nurses, registered dietitians, product and project managers, and others, and finally to members, participants or clients of those organizations or of the general public
  • Work collaboratively with the MA, business development and clinical strategy teams to meet and exceed referral and meal volume targets and retain book of business without attrition ensure positive account status, drive sales forecast performance, growth goals, and key initiatives
  • Schedule monthly (preferred) or quarterly meetings with MA health plan accounts to drive utilization, expand services, provide updates, ensure smooth partnership processes and that all new hires receive in-service training
  • Monitor utilization, prepare commentary and updates and deliver reporting to all accounts during monthly or quarterly meetings
  • Build a schedule of staff meetings, in-service presentations and conferences where target audiences meet and coordinate presentation of our product and service
  • Attend relevant webinar and stay up to date with all MA program changes
  • Work with marketing team to ensure program alignment and proper representation of Mom’s Meals in account communications.
  • Ensure that program changes are communicated internally to key stakeholders
  • Maintain CareLink database documenting sales leads and contacts, scheduled meetings and in-services
  • Use appropriate channels to request reports internally and deliver reports to MA health plan as needed to improve operational efficiency
  • Resolve any billing, intake or operational issues with internal partners and communicate the value of our services and partnership so that Mom’s Meals is recognized as a preferred and strategic partner
  • Serve as a representative for Mom’s Meals at conferences by coordinating and setting up display tables or booths, engaging with attendees to promote awareness of our services, and following up with leads to schedule training or business expansion meetings
  • Cross collaborate with implementation, customer care, intake, data analytics, IT, contracting, revenue cycle, compliance, product, business development, and clinical strategy teams where appropriate
  • Engage and promote awareness of Mom’s Meals and continuously seek out opportunities for growth and expansion

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree
  • 5+ years’ healthcare sales experience in areas such as managed care, long-term care, home health, home care, hospital or medical equipment
  • Knowledge of Medicaid/Medicare benefit programs
  • Demonstrated experience consulting and presenting to care providers for high‑risk member populations
  • Sincerity and passion about helping people
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills – Outlook, Teams, PowerBI, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams
  • Experience with CRM, Salesforce or similar organizational sales software
  • A strong background in Medicare/Medicaid and Managed Care organizations
  • Clinical credentialing in Social Work, Nursing, or Nutrition and/or be able to communicate the critical importance of medical nutrition in reducing health care costs to this high‑risk population
  • Familiarity and contacts within the specific regional market along with experience working in Medicaid service provision
  • Willingness to travel up to 20‑30% of the time for day and overnight trips, both regionally and nationwide with flexibility to hold virtual meetings when appropriate

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Individuals with clinical background, such as registered dietitian, licensed social worker or nursing case manager, with customer relationship experience will be strongly considered
  • Advanced degree, such as MS, MA, MPH, MSW, MBA, MHA

Physical Requirements

Compensation Type: Yearly – Highgate Hotels

Highgate is a premier real estate investment and hospitality management company widely recognized as an innovator in the industry. Highgate is the dominant player in U.S. gateway markets including New York, Boston, Miami, San Francisco and Honolulu, with a rapidly expanding presence in Europe, Latin America, and the Caribbean. Highgate’s portfolio of global properties represents an aggregate asset value exceeding $20B and generates over $5B in cumulative revenues. The company provides expert guidance through all stages of the hospitality property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate also has the creativity and bandwidth to develop bespoke hotel brands and utilizes industry‑leading proprietary revenue management tools that identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive out performance and maximize asset value. With an executive team consisting of some of the industry’s most experienced hotel management leaders, the company is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. Highgate maintains corporate offices in London, New York, Dallas, and Seattle.

Location Overview

The Revenue Manager is responsible for identifying and maximizing all potential revenue opportunities for the hotel. In today’s lodging environment, understanding channel and yield management is critical for maximizing revenues. The Revenue Manager is responsible for formulating long and short‑term Revenue Management strategies and for overseeing their successful execution towards the advancement of RevPAR market share. This includes the analysis of revenue potential generated by the transient and group market segments as well as the market segmentation within transient and group. This is a remote position.

Responsibilities

  • Establish hotel pricing levels in all segments.
  • Responsible for the daily room inventory management process and daily pricing process.
  • Monitor competitor rates, positioning, strategies and data; maintain understanding of the dynamics of the local market and demand generators and present appropriate action plans to management.
  • Monitor and communicate fluctuations in occupancy to operational departments so they can effectively manage staffing requirements and increase efficiency.
  • Analyze local events and activities and project the effect of opportunities they create.
  • Understand the macro and micro-economic variables affecting supply and demand in the local marketplace, and use this knowledge to create accurate operational and financial room revenue forecasts.
  • Perform unconstrained demand analysis to determine optimal business mix.
  • Responsible for all short and long term forecasts including Weekly Forecasts, Forecasts, In the month forecasts, and Full year forecasts.
  • Oversee process for evaluating all opportunities for contracted business (group, wholesale, corporate negotiated, etc.) presented through the Sales department. Ensure that process enables high speed of response while maximizing profits.
  • Responsible for the maintenance of any software programs which contribute to the management of rooms revenue, including the CRS, RMS, PMS and Sales & Catering system.
  • Monitor RevPAR index on STR report and provide critical analysis of performance on weekly and monthly basis.
  • Prepare annual Rooms revenue budget.
  • Chair weekly Revenue Strategy meetings in order to formulate and disseminate strategies and tactics. Ensure that prior decisions are re-visited in this forum in order to evaluate their effectiveness and promote learning.
  • Prepare and present quarterly presentations to ownership.
  • Ensure all distribution channels have correct content and pricing.
  • Develop and maintain a close relationship with the market manager of Third Party Intermediaries to maximize the opportunities with these channels.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with other market revenue managers and Directors of Revenue to create a network of peers in your community
  • Coordinate survey activities involving marketing and service opportunities to further enhance revenue potential.
  • Actively develop all subordinates, ensuring that they have opportunities to grow their Revenue Management and leadership skill base through personal attention, internal/external training and participation in industry events.
  • Responsible for Internet Marketing such as pay per click campaigns, e-mail blasts, GDS advertising, etc.
  • Establish and communicate sales strategy for day, week, month and rolling 12 months.
  • Communicate any strategy changes or update any calendars for the sales team to use.
  • Analyze prior night successes: Did the hotel sell out? Were the right decisions made for overselling? Address the opportunities in Highgate Hotel Business Review (HHBR) morning meeting.
  • Place test calls to Central Reservation Office (CRO) and property to ensure accuracy of rate quoting, restrictions and selling approach.
  • Manage and communicate group cut off dates. Run a group rooms control log (GRC) as well as pick up report from Property Management System (PMS) for 90 days. Verify pick up to actual block, cut off date, and whether or not you should extend, etc.
  • Update the Daily Market Segment Analysis (DMSA). Ensure accuracy from the daily Flash Report. Review actual performance versus Potential performance.
  • Complete all required month end reports with detailed analysis. If necessary, complete action plans for the property to follow to create additional production/revenue.
  • Review Hotelligence reports for trends, booking windows and sources of business as well as rates compared to competition.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years experience in the Revenue Management field as manager or senior analyst
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Hotel or Hospitality Management or closely related field
  • In-Depth knowledge of all industry reports such as STR, Hotelligence, Market Vision, etc.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point
  • Ability to work quickly in a high-pressure & high stress environment
  • Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Exceptional with details and follow up
  • Flexible and long hours sometimes required.
  • Maintain a warm and friendly demeanor at all times.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate both verbally and written, with all level of employees and guests in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service oriented manner.
  • Must be effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying concerns raised by employees and guests.
  • Must be able to multitask and prioritize departmental functions to meet deadlines.
  • Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.
  • Attend all hotel required meetings and trainings.
  • Participate in M.O.D. coverage as required.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Highgate Hotel Standards, as required by scheduling, which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
  • Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing nametags.
  • Comply with Highgate Hotel Standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.
  • Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in implementing solutions.
  • Must be effective in handling problems, including anticipating, preventing, identifying and solving problems as necessary.
  • Must be able to understand and evaluate complex information, data, etc. from various sources to meet appropriate objectives.
  • Must be able to maintain confidentiality of information.
  • Perform other duties as requested by management

title: AMXL Operations Specialist, AMXL
description:
Our logistics teams are transforming the way we interact with customers around the world, every day, and solving some of the biggest logistics challenges faced not only by Amazon, but by the entire industry. Whether items are large or small, we develop solutions to ensure that we deliver on our promise to the customer.

Amazon Logistics Brazil (AMZL) is looking for a Logistics Operations Specialist to join the AMXL (logistics operations for large items) team. This person will be the focal point for operational activities carried out by third‑party partners. The operations take place 7 days a week, including holidays, with a 4x3 scale, distributed between front and back office teams.

The professional will be responsible for managing delivery stations operated by external logistics partners, ensuring the performance, compliance, and standardization of processes. It will play a fundamental role in tactical execution aimed at growth, expansion and maintenance of quality and operational excellence.

You will work in a highly collaborative, dynamic and fast‑paced environment — closer to a start‑up than to a large corporation. We adopt the mindset that no idea is bad and that the best ideas should be tested and tried.

It's essential that this person is able to thrive in an ambiguous and fast environment, delivering consistent results. Some of the activities will be carried out remotely, while others will include audits and in‑person visits to the logistics partners' operations.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Manage end‑to‑end the stations operated by logistics partners, ensuring efficiency, compliance, safety and the best customer experience.
  • Act operationally in managing the daily routine, ensuring the execution of processes, volume monitoring, and resolution of deviations.
  • Monitor and optimize operating costs, identifying opportunities to reduce expenses and increase productivity without compromising quality.
  • Manage operational capacity, anticipating peaks in demand and ensuring adequate resources, infrastructure, and teams for current and future volumes.
  • Develop, implement, and lead tactical and expansion projects, such as network adjustments and optimization of logistics flows.
  • Define and monitor strategic metrics and KPIs with logistics partners, implementing action plans to achieve or exceed goals.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, using insights for critical and quick decisions.
  • Act as the main link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment of objectives, deadlines, and compliance.

A day in the life

The Logistics Operations Specialist manages the operation of outsourced delivery stations, ensuring efficiency, compliance and quality. The role combines tactical analysis of metrics with operational management of the daily routine, resolving ground‑level deviations. It collaborates closely with internal teams such as Planning, Security and Supply Chain, as well as external partners. The specialist is responsible for ensuring adequate capacity for peak demand and presenting business cases for improvements. The focus is on ensuring that large items are delivered with speed and excellence, guaranteeing the best customer experience.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience managing large data sets and utilizing them to drive performance and process improvements.
  • Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (pivot tables & charts, multiple‑criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.).
  • Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent.
  • English language skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL.

title: Ux Designer
description:
Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware .

Overview

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades. Our games are inspired by classic and modern JRPGs, blending combat, exploration, and narrative. As a UX Designer on our team, you'll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment‑to‑moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player‑first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game‑genre‑aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low‑fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine, ideally Unity.
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player‑first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system‑heavy or narrative‑rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing for console or controller‑first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

How to Apply

Send your e‑mail to "******" with a subject like "UX Designer- Your Name". Include your resume and portfolio and feel free to share any details about yourself that you'd like to share.

About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio founded in ****, committed to creating player‑first video games that craft compelling stories and lasting experiences. We are self‑funded and early in a new JRPG project.

  • Problem Breakdown and Task Management: Decompose complex challenges into clear, actionable tasks.

  • Team Collaboration and Support: Foster a collaborative, supportive team environment, encouraging open communication and peer learning.
  • Proactive Conflict Resolution: Identify potential conflicts or bottlenecks early and resolve them independently or collaboratively.
  • Technology Trends Monitoring: Stay current with emerging technologies, evaluating relevance and potential process improvement.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of software development experience, including 1–2 years in a technical lead or equivalent leadership role.
  • Proven leadership of technical projects from inception to completion.
  • Mastery of relevant programming languages, frameworks, and development tools.
  • Strong experience with Contentful.
  • Strong experience with Webflow, WordPress, ReactJS, JavaScript, AWS, and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with Nuxt.js.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture and design patterns.
  • Expertise in agile development methodologies and project management tools.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong leadership, mentorship, and task delegation capabilities.
  • Ability to adapt to evolving technologies and industry trends.
  • Experience driving process improvement and change within a team or organization.

  • Mid‑Senior level

  • Full‑time

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

About The Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Manager, Paid Search - a performance-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI. Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.

Perfect candidates will be obsessed with Paid Search Advertising, experts at search buying behavior, with a clear demonstrated history of selling products through paid search advertising, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and breath ads manager, you are curious about the emerging AI advertising ecosystem, and performance marketing at large. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Brazil, and Mexico

What you’ll do

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies exclusively focused on Paid Search to increase brand visibility and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.
  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.

  • Manage between 6-10 Paid Media accounts (including Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI search platforms like Koah and Kontext) with aggregate monthly spends between $20,000 and $3M.
  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, and AI to develop insights and action items to increase client revenues month over month and improve attribution.
  • Maintain mastery of KPIs such as CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM.
  • Understand industry benchmarks across the e-commerce marketing funnel.
  • Implement real-time and proactive ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to trends on ads platforms.
  • Develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on performance metrics, ad spend, and projections.
  • Perform competitive and brand research to guide marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and results review.
  • Understand full-funnel marketing to ensure healthy new customer acquisition within the broader e-commerce equation.
  • Deliver projections and forecasts to support client quarterly strategy.
  • Willingness to learn e-commerce P&Ls and engage with financial metrics.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • Mastery of the e-commerce marketing funnel — from offer to ad to landing page to conversion.
  • 7+ years of paid media advertising experience within Paid Search, specifically Google (building high-converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).
  • 5+ years managing paid search for growing consumer clients spending at least $400k per month in aggregate.
  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short-form video creative.
  • Expertise in creative consultation for paid social ads that convert.
  • Experience with data-driven decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend linked to results.
  • Experience with core e-commerce revenue drivers and reporting on metrics such as CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, CPM.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. There is no room for mediocrity. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.

You’ll collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game genre-aware solutions
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity)
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics
  • A player-first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices
  • Excellent communication skills. You can explain your reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games

Our mission is clear and ambitious: to train and employ family caregivers so they can get paid for the care they already provide at home. Abby Care is building a tech-powered, family-first care platform to efficiently deliver care, improve health outcomes, and provide the best-in-class experience nationwide. We are rapidly expanding our mission and looking for passionate team members to join. Abby Care has partnered with leading insurance plans, healthcare providers, and community organizations. We’re supported by top, mission-driven VCs to empower families throughout the country.

The Role

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 12:00 PM - 8:00 PM Eastern Time.

We’re looking for passionate and empathetic hustlers to join us. This is not your typical sales or customer success position. Instead, you’ll be working with real families with real human problems. Your role is to empower underserved families to take the most transformative step of their life to access care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the family empowerment function. You’ll be in charge of managing our family training pipeline, pushing families to reach their maximum potential and to obtain best-in-class clinical training to best care for others.
  • Uplift our families. You’ll guide families through the healthcare and training maze. You are their biggest cheerleader during the highest highs and lowest lows.
  • Partner with technology, clinical, and product teams across Abby Care. You\'ll be a critical voice for collaboration among initiatives to further our mission.
  • Build a thriving community. You will play an integral role in building out our Abby Care community, helping coordinate meet-ups, introducing families to each other, and organizing events, seminars, and conversations that empower families to rely on one another to get through the sometimes bumpy roads.

Qualifications

  • Fluent in speaking Spanish and English
  • At least 1-4 years of sales or customer success experience in a professional role. This can mean (but is not limited to) you have work experience in any of the following areas:
    • Sales Development Representative
    • Account Management
    • Customer Success Development
    • Call Center Development
  • Excellent project management and process execution skills. You know how to handle complex and cross-functional initiatives, set goals, and optimize workflows.
  • Experience in business analytics and performance measurement (or willing to learn). You’ve used a myriad of tools spanning from spreadsheets to growth dashboards.
  • Deep empathy, endless tenacity, charisma, and patience.

Our Values

  • Families First: Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”
  • Urgency with Precision: Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.
  • Relentlessly Resourceful: As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.
  • Purpose with Positivity: We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.
  • Driven to redefine What’s Possible: We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation packages that reflect the value you bring. Global team members are eligible for an annual company performance bonus.
  • Generous paid time off: 15 days PTO plus 10 paid company US holidays.
  • Team bonding: full-time employees participate in team activities and our annual company retreat.
  • Set Up for Success: company-issued laptop provided.
  • Growth Opportunities: build leadership skills across US markets.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, consistent with applicable laws. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, satisfactory references, and any required documentation.

description:
Field Service Technician - Temporary 12 months

Join to apply for the Field Service Technician - Temporary 12 months role at Flowserve Corporation.

Job Summary

The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries, such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. In this position, the Field Service Technician (FST) offers real-time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment. The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites. Our team of Field Service Technicians is the face of Flowserve and we rely on them to provide world-class service to our customers, creating a lasting competitive advantage for our products and services.

Responsibilities

  • Perform direct, in-person service calls in response to customer requests;
  • Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly;
  • Work side-by-side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required;
  • Supervising the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly;
  • Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule;
  • Checking equipment before commissioning and start-up and evaluating performance during and after equipment start-up;
  • Monitoring the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment;
  • Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products;
  • Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering;
  • Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged;
  • Other duties as assigned;

Requirements

  • Mechanical Technician with active CFT;
  • Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry;
  • Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment;
  • Experience in installing mechanical equipment;
  • Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc.;
  • Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference;
  • Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges;
  • Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;
  • Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills;
  • Intermediate English
  • An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job;
  • Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods;
  • Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers;
  • Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

Desirable Skills

  • Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable;
  • Professional certifications in this area.

About Flowserve

Flowserve is a world-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. We support 10,000+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet needs of customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally.

NUTRICIONISTA - PRODUÇÃO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Executar atividades de nutrição revisando os cardápios e dietas dos pacientes, bem como adequando o teor nutricional dos alimentos a fim de assegurar o atendimento das prescrições médicas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição

Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Nutrição em Pediatria, Nutrição em Materno Infantil, Nutrição Clínica, Nutrição Geriatria e Gerontologia, Nutrição em Fitoterapia Nutricional ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Nutricionista.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: YouTube Manager
description:
Overview

A Impact Media is on a mission to empower real estate professionals to own their market through media. We hire for impact and align with our core values: beyond excellence, extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and mission focus. When you apply, please use the subject line: "I actually read the instructions".

Role

We are hiring a YouTube Manager for A Impact Media. The YouTube Manager is a strategic and creative leader who connects our clients' business priorities to long-form video content. This role goes beyond managing channels: you'll help build the top real estate channels nationwide, craft standout content, and establish scalable systems for uploads that drive local authority with hundreds of thousands of impressions per year on YouTube. You're a multifaceted creator skilled in ideation, production planning, compelling copywriting, post-production oversight, and YouTube analytics. You'll lead production, posting, and packaging, distill insights into engaging content, and maintain alignment with key business initiatives. You'll collaborate with our YouTube Strategists/Client Success Manager, the creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

If the idea of leading and growing YouTube's top real estate channels excites you, let's talk.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure
    • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre-production team across multiple client accounts
    • Support YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
    • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
    • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
    • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre- and post-production workflows; prototype AI-driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
    • Coordinate with marketing, shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion
  • YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture
    • Support YouTube channel growth strategy with input from clients
    • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and experimental formats
    • Ensure every video educates while reinforcing the client's authority, credibility, and mission; maintain each brand's distinct tone with consistency
    • Support the visual identity of packaging and run A/B tests on back catalogue
    • Keep relevant YouTube scorecard metrics and present weekly insights to team and clients
  • Pre-Production
    • Support ideation and research sessions
    • Provide feedback on packaging briefs and video outlines
    • Maintain a four-to-six-week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts, and title options)
  • Post-Production
    • Own post-production timelines and the upload calendar
    • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve audience engagement
    • Work with Senior Editor to provide retention notes on edits and final approval for uploads
    • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to streamline post-production
  • Results
    • Support 45-60+ videos monthly across your team, managing around 5-10 client channels
    • 90%+ on-time delivery rate
    • Client channels achieving subscriber growth monthly
    • Support client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and $7.5-10M+ in annual sales per client)
    • 50-75% of videos outperform channel baselines on impressions and subscriber growth
    • Lift in subscriber-to-view ratios and higher average views with faster velocity
    • Documentation of content experiments and A/B tests
    • Improved use of AI and tools to increase team leverage
    • Positive client sentiment on brand and growth

Requirements

  • Understanding of YouTube landscape – concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant YouTube channel development experience (bonus for large educational channels)
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (e.g., Frame.io)
  • Proficiency with Notion and GSuite
  • Editing and Photoshop knowledge is a plus but not essential

Communication Expectations

  • We use Slack as the go-to for communications
  • We value over-communication and speed of responses, with context when delays occur
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings
  • Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader
  • Weekly meetings with the creative team

Location

Remote (work from home)

Hours

Mon - Fri 9am - 6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed

Compensation

$16,800 - $28,800 USD annually with progression from part-time to full-time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000 to $36,000 USD a year.

Benefits

  • 30-60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part-time to full-time path)
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Performance-based advancement opportunities

Core Values

Our core values are the heart of this company: Beyond Excellence, Extreme Ownership, Proactive Curiosity, and Mission Focused. The right person will subscribe to these values and understand why they are critical to success.

How to Apply

To apply, submit the following:

  • Resume in PDF format named as: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube-Manager.pdf)
  • Links to YouTube channels you've managed and their growth metrics (or your portfolio)
  • Link to your completed personality quiz:
  • Answer: What's the most innovative YouTube strategy you've implemented and what were the results?
  • Answer: What does the quote "Work is love made visible" mean to you?

Submissions should go to:

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck on your job search!

Overview

Sunbit builds financial technology for real life. Our technology eases the stress of paying for life’s expenses by giving people more options on how and when they pay. Founded in 2016, Sunbit offers a next-generation, no-fee credit card that can be managed through a powerful mobile app, as well as a point-of-sale payment option available at more than 25,000 service locations, including auto dealership service centers, optical practices, dental offices, veterinary clinics, and specialty healthcare services. Sunbit was included on the 2022 Inc. 5000 list and has been named a Most Loved Workplace®, Best Point of Sale Company, and a Top Fintech Startup by CB Insights.

We use cutting-edge innovations in financial technology to bring leading data and features that allow individuals to be qualified instantly, making purchases at the point-of-sale fast, fair, and easy for consumers from all walks of life. We create value focused on our core values; we work tirelessly to ensure that Sunbit becomes available to everyone, everywhere.

We invite you to #UnleashyourCuriosity and join our ever-growing R&D organization.

What You’ll Do

As the Card Risk Lead, you will manage a mission-critical team central to the Credit Card, Sunbit’s flagship product, that is responsible for developing and implementing Sunbit's core risk management strategies. Leading a dynamic team of backend engineers and AI/ML specialists, your contributions will directly impact Sunbit’s key performance indicators and overall success. This position is both strategic and hands-on, involving the architecture and implementation of scalable systems that power the core financial risk of the Card product. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing fintech company, influence the product at its core, and shape the way credit and risk are managed across our platform.

Among your key responsibilities, you will lead a highly skilled team that architects and builds scalable systems that detect and mitigate financial risks in real time.

  • Work closely with the business and senior leadership.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including AI/ML engineers, product managers, analysts, and other engineering squads, to align risk management strategies with business goals.
  • Proactively maintain the stability, security, and adaptability of the financial risk management systems.
  • Leverage data analysis and insights to ensure alignment with the company’s growth and evolving business needs.
  • Respond quickly and proactively to emerging trends, delivering fast, impactful solutions that protect the product's financial success.

Qualifications

  • B.Sc in computer science or equivalent.
  • Experience managing a team (preferably 3+ years) and leading projects hands-on from start to finish (preferably 8+ years, focusing on system architecture).
  • Proficiency in modern system architecture with large-scale and high performance.
  • Impact driven - use data to make sure every task moves the needle and utilize your resources to maximize the team's impact.
  • Team player, with strong communication skills and someone who thrives working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Creative, solution-oriented, and able to maintain a ‘can do’ attitude, with the ability to work efficiently under pressure and uncertainty. Adapt quickly to changing business needs.
  • Passion for data.
  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Fluent in English.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with software development in Python.
  • Experience with cloud technology.
  • Experience in managing data specialists (AI/ML engineers, analysts).

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

We’ve been made aware of fraudsters impersonating Sunbit employees during the hiring process. Please note that all official communication will come from an @sunbit.com email address, through our applicant tracking platform or directly via LinkedIn. We will never ask for your age, Social Security number, bank account details, payment of any kind, or other unrelated personal information during the application process. Our hiring process always includes interviews, either by phone, zoom, or in person, before any offer is made. If something feels suspicious, please contact to confirm. We ask that you contact only about potential instances of fraud. does not reach our recruiting team directly. Your application directly through the posting is the best way to ensure that your candidacy is reviewed by our team. Due to the volume of applications, we will not respond to nor forward emails about your candidacy that are sent to directly, and your email about your application will be deleted from our systems.

Staff Analytics Engineering Lead | Data Delivery

Join to apply for the Staff Analytics Engineering Lead | Data Delivery role at Wellhub

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we’re revolutionizing workplace wellness by connecting employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one subscription. Headquarters in NYC, team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Analytics Engineering Lead for our Data Delivery team in Brazil. This is a remote – Brazil position. Only candidates located in Brazil are eligible.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead key initiatives for the Data Delivery team, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring alignment between technical execution and company-wide data strategy.
  • Drive the Shift Left movement by defining patterns, standards, and tools that enable microservice teams to expose high‑quality, consumable data with robust data contracts.
  • Architect and champion robust data models within our data warehouse (Medallion Architecture) to ensure consistency and adherence to central data concepts, enhancing reliability of reporting and analysis.
  • Empower the distributed Data Chapter by providing the highest‑quality, discoverable datasets necessary for business and product insights.
  • Manage cross‑functional data initiatives, establish clear roadmaps, communicate progress and risks to senior stakeholders across Business Units and Product Tech Unit.
  • Act as a technical product owner for data assets, gathering complex requirements and translating them into actionable data delivery plans.
  • Collaborate with Data Platform and Data Solutions teams to ensure transformation and tooling (e.g., Trino, Airflow, OpenMetadata) align with delivery needs.
  • Design and maintain scalable, high‑integrity data models (dimensional, facts, aggregated marts) optimized for Trino performance and self‑service analytics.
  • Develop robust, test‑driven ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and SQL in Airflow to transform raw microservice data into gold‑standard domain datasets.
  • Champion data governance practices, ensuring models and transformations enforce company data concepts and quality standards.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance on best practices in data modeling and pipeline development to other Data Delivery engineers.
  • Live the mission by inspiring and empowering others, fostering a supportive environment where wellbeing and work‑life wellness are prioritized.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced Data and/or Analytics Engineer with a proven track record of managing complex data projects and influencing technical direction.
  • Successfully led and delivered large‑scale data initiatives in distributed environments.
  • Deep understanding of data modeling principles (dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, domain‑driven design) and ability to balance flexibility, consistency, and performance.
  • Effective communicator, engaging engineering, product, and senior management stakeholders.
  • Comfortable with hub‑and‑spoke operating model, advocating for central consistency while supporting distributed data ownership.
  • Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation and pipeline construction.
  • Proven expertise in designing and optimizing data warehouse or lakehouse models.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed query engines (Trino/Presto) and query optimization.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools like Airflow.
  • Advanced knowledge of data governance, data quality checks, and semantic consistency across domains.
  • Strong communication with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Roadblock management, task prioritization, and roadmap ownership.
  • Familiarity with data cataloging tools such as OpenMetadata.
  • Prior involvement in organizational transformation toward Shift Left or Data Mesh approaches is a plus.

Competencies Required

  • Expert proficiency in SQL and Python.
  • Designing and optimizing Data Warehouse or Lakehouse data models.
  • Understanding of distributed query engines and query optimization.
  • Experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools.
  • Advanced data governance and quality checks (e.g., Great Expectations).
  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration.
  • Roadmap, task management, and prioritization.
  • Familiarity with data cataloging and discovery tools such as OpenMetadata.
  • Experience with a Shift Left or Data Mesh approach accelerates success.

What We Offer You

  • Free Gold+ membership with gym and studio access, digital fitness programs, and wellness resources.
  • Wellz: personalized therapy sessions and on‑demand content.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • Hybrid and remote flexibility, including home office reimbursement.
  • Flexible scheduling aligned with time zones and personal routines.
  • Paid time off: vacations after 6 months, additional days per tenure, and a birthday holiday.
  • 100% paid parental leave with extended and ramp‑back options.
  • Career growth through world‑class platforms and internal opportunities.
  • Inclusive culture that values trust, open communication, and diverse perspectives.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging

Wellhub is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Working Hours: Central Time Zone (CST)

About The Company

Our client is a fast-growing retail company operating 30+ locations across the U.S., with plans to add multiple new locations annually. The business is scaling rapidly, backed by strong leadership and a modern approach to operations. They’re looking for a hands-on, experienced Controller to build structure, improve processes, and bring financial rigor to the company’s next stage of growth.

About The Role

The Financial Controller will oversee all accounting operations, manage a small bookkeeping team, and own the monthly close and reporting process. This is a role for a seasoned professional who thrives in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment — someone who can roll up their sleeves, streamline processes, and provide accurate, timely insights to leadership.

You’ll collaborate closely with the CFO and the executive team to strengthen financial systems, implement automation, and support budgeting and forecasting. The ideal candidate is CPA-qualified, process-driven, and experienced in leading accounting operations for a multi-unit or retail-based business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including reconciliations, journal entries, month-end, and year-end close.
  • Manage and mentor a team of bookkeepers, ensuring accuracy and accountability.
  • Prepare consolidated financial statements and maintain the general ledger across multiple entities.
  • Oversee cash reconciliations, accounts payable, and accounts receivable functions.
  • Develop and improve accounting policies, processes, and internal controls, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency.
  • Leverage accounting software (ideally Xero) to maintain accurate books and streamline reporting.
  • Utilize reporting tools like Fathom (or similar) to produce management reports and dashboards.
  • Partner with the CFO and P&L owners to support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Produce accurate, timely financial and management reports to support decision-making.
  • Support external auditors during audits and ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP. Collaborate cross-functionally with operations and leadership to maintain financial visibility across all laundromat locations.

Qualifications

  • CPA required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2+ years in a Controller or similar leadership role
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and multi-entity accounting
  • Proven experience managing bookkeeping or accounting staff, ideally in an offshore or remote setup
  • Hands-on experience with monthly close, reconciliations, and reporting

  • Audit experience preferred (not required)

  • Experience in retail, multi-location, or franchise-style businesses preferred
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken
