  • Tem experiência com Dagster (ou ferramentas equivalentes) para orquestração de pipelines.
  • Entende profundamente ambientes multi-cloud (AWS e GCP) e sabe tirar o máximo proveito de ambos.
  • Já implementou práticas sólidas de governança, observabilidade e linhagem de dados.
  • Possui experiência com arquitetura de dados e Data Warehouses modernos, equilibrando performance e custo.
  • É uma pessoa proativa, analítica e com mentalidade de produto, que se preocupa em entregar dados úteis, acessíveis e confiáveis.

Overview

Como Administrador(a) de Banco de Dados Sênior (DBA), com especialidade em SQL Server, você gerenciará e manterá o sistema de banco de dados SQL Server, garantindo a integridade dos dados, performance e segurança. Lidera iniciativas complexas, orienta DBAs mais juniores e atua como referência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Instalar, configurar e manter instâncias e bancos de dados SQL Server (versões 2012 a 2022).
  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Recovery (Full, Differential, Transaction log, Point-in-time recovery).
  • Implementar, gerenciar e solucionar problemas em soluções de Alta Disponibilidade (HA) & Disaster Recovery (DR), como Always On Availability Groups e Replicação Transacional.
  • Gerenciar a segurança do banco de dados, incluindo usuários, roles, permissões, e implementar recursos como Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Data Masking e Row-Level Security.
  • Configurar e gerenciar a Auditoria do SQL Server para fins de segurança e conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Realizar tuning e otimização de performance de queries complexas, analisando planos de execução, utilizando Query Store e definindo estratégias de indexação.
  • Gerenciar e manter índices (Clustered, Non-Clustered, Columnstore) e estatísticas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de diagnóstico como SQL Profiler, Extended Events e DMVs para identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance.
  • Realizar tuning de I/O, CPU e Memória para otimizar a performance do SQL Server.
  • Otimizar a configuração e uso do TempDB.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de concorrência, como Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Desenvolver T-SQL complexo, incluindo stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, CTEs, Dynamic SQL e manipulação de XML/JSON.
  • Desenvolver scripts em PowerShell para automação de tarefas administrativas e de manutenção.
  • Criar, gerenciar e otimizar Jobs complexos no SQL Server Agent.
  • Administrar ambientes de banco de dados na nuvem (Azure SQL Database, SQL Server em VMs - IaaS, Managed Instances - PaaS) e híbridos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Disaster Recovery na nuvem.
  • Utilizar Azure Data Factory para fluxos de integração de dados.
  • Desenvolver, implantar e manter pacotes SSIS para migração e transformação de dados (ETL).
  • Implementar e gerenciar Change Data Capture (CDC) e Change Tracking.
  • Implementar monitoramento proativo da saúde dos bancos de dados e health checks.
  • Utilizar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento de terceiros (ex: Redgate, DataDog SentryOne, SQL Monitor).
  • Desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas de manutenção e criação de alertas.
  • Configurar, gerenciar e analisar logs de auditoria e monitoramento de atividades no SQL Server.
  • Implementar e gerenciar a automação de deployments de banco de dados (ex: Flyway, Liquibase, Redgate).
  • Integrar o gerenciamento de código de banco de dados com sistemas de controle de versão (Git, Azure DevOps, SVN).
  • Integrar e manter deployments de banco de dados em pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas e projetos de banco de dados.
  • Orientar DBAs de níveis júnior e pleno.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre o ambiente de banco de dados.

Requisitos básicos

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência consolidada (8+ anos) em administração de banco de dados, com especialidade em SQL Server.
  • Profundo conhecimento em instalação, configuração e manutenção do SQL Server (versões 2012, 2014, 2016, 2019, 2022).
  • Experiência prática com estratégias de Backup e Recovery
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança SQL Server
  • Experiência com requisitos de conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Domínio de Performance Tuning
  • Experiência com ferramentas de diagnóstico de performance: SQL Profiler, Extended Events, DMVs.
  • Conhecimento em tuning de I/O, CPU, Memória e otimização de TempDB.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting de Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento T-SQL complexo

  • Conhecimento em Data Warehousing e integração com ferramentas de BI

description:
Overview

ROI Hunter is a SaaS AdTech company founded in 2014 that develops Product Performance Management (PPM) solutions to help e-commerce businesses automate and scale their digital promotions. As an official partner of Meta, Google, and Snapchat, the company empowers enterprise retailers with data-driven insights for their online campaigns. With 89 employees and a global presence across multiple continents, ROI Hunter has grown from a project among friends into an international company while maintaining its open, flexible culture.

Who we are looking for

Who are we looking for? We’re on the hunt for an enthusiastic Customer Support Specialist who thrives on tackling technical and marketing challenges for our platform's clients. Our Support team is the backbone of our company - join us and become one of the heroes!

Where

This is a remote position, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home in Brazil.

About the role

  • As a Customer Support Specialist at ROI Hunter, you\'ll be at the forefront of client assistance, primarily engaging with them through Intercom, as well as other communication channels like chat and email, serving clients on the Brazilian market but also globally
  • You will provide technical support regarding Meta and Google marketing issues within our platform
  • Processing and discussing product feedback with our product managers, and reporting any discovered issues
  • Share ideas for continuous improvement and new learnings

About you

  • You are a self-starter who is based anywhere in Brazil and can work remotely. Our team is supporting each other, so there is a helping hand. But consider if the remote setup is the one for you
  • You should be truly enthusiastic about technical support - we would like to find someone who will stay in this position for at least 2 years (do not worry, the job is never the same)
  • Being fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese is a must, together with patience and empathy are important tools for a successful Customer Support Specialist
  • Some basics in Meta and/or Google Ads will be a great plus
  • You will be working remotely with us so we expect you already have the home office setup ready

Perks and benefits

  • ☕ Meal vouchers (of BRL 35/working day)
  • 30 days of paid vacation leave per year of service accrued gradually
  • Quarterly bonuses

…but we still believe the most important thing is the culture we create and live every day. So, what\'s it like to work with us?

WE CARE ABOUT

AUTONOMY AND FLEXIBILITY – We trust each other. Impact and delivered outcomes are more important than spending the whole day in the office with poor results. We can choose the approach and solutions to our work tasks as long as we can deliver the outcomes. To achieve that, we all must be accountable, self-driven and proactive.

LEARNING TOGETHER AND OUR GROWTH – we won\'t go far if we hide our findings or hoard our knowledge. It’s all about collaboration and discussions. We love feedback . We support each other, as well as our personal development and education based on our job needs.

title: Manager, Paid Search
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Manager, Paid Search - a performance-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI (some of these platforms don’t have ad services yet). Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.

Perfect candidates will be obsessed with Paid Search Advertising, experts at search buying behavior, with a clear demonstrated history of selling products through paid search advertising, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and breath ads manager, you are curious about the emerging AI advertising ecosystem, and performance marketing at large. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands‑on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Brazil, and Mexico

What you’ll do:

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies exclusively focused on Paid Search to increase brand visibility and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.

  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.

  • Obsession with the paid search advertising action, bid system, and market dynamics to best convert customers at the lowest possible cost for the brand.

  • Keen to develop innovative paid search strategies that blend traditional search, YouTube, and emerging AI search.

  • Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.

  • Manage between 6-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Google, YouTube, Bing, and the emerging AI sSearch Platforms (Koah, Kontext) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $20,000 - $3M.

  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, and AI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.

  • Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM.

  • Understand industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.

  • Implement real-time, proactive, and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).

  • Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.

  • Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.

  • Understand full-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e-commerce equation.

  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.

  • Willingness and openness to learn and understand e-commerce P&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • Mastery of the e-commerce marketing funnel —> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.

  • 7+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Search, Google in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).

  • 5+ years minimum managing paid search advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.

  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative.

  • Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert.

  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results.

  • Experience with all core e-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, CPM).

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Generous Quarterly Bonuses: Your productivity directly translates to your compensation. We offer a competitive quarterly bonus structure that is both substantial and customized to your role, ensuring your hard work is consistently and generously rewarded.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Quem somos Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes. Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo. Estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes. Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão: mapear as necessidades do cliente para oferecer soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da empresa, buscando oportunidades em novas áreas, aumentar presença em grupos econômicos.
  • Negociar e fechar contratos: atuar diretamente nas negociações de expansão de contratos.
  • Parceria interna: colaborar com equipes de Customer Success, Produto e Marketing para entregar valor contínuo e alinhar estratégias.
  • Análise de dados e métricas: monitorar o desempenho das contas, como Net Revenue Retention (NRR), churn e expansão, para orientar ações estratégicas.
  • Gestão de pipeline: manter um pipeline atualizado com foco em oportunidades de expansão.
  • Acompanhar portfólio de clientes: desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com decisores e influenciadores das contas existentes.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em vendas, em posições de Account Executive, Farmer ou similar, preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia B2B.
  • Experiência com negociações complexas com grandes contas, gestão e crescimento de contas Enterprise ou KA.
  • Habilidade em negociação: expertise em lidar com contratos complexos e longos ciclos de vendas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de vendas: familiaridade com técnicas como SPIN Selling, Challenger Sales, ou similares.
  • Orientação por dados: capacidade de analisar métricas como NET New, ARPA, LTV e churn para embasar decisões.
  • Habilidades excepcionais de comunicação, organização, escuta ativa, construção de relacionamentos e resolução de problemas.

Pontos a mais se você possui

  • Conhecimento em soluções de ERP ou plataformas financeiras.
  • Certificações em metodologias de vendas (ex.: MEDDIC, Sandler, Training Challenger Sale).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas HubSpot ou CRMs equivalentes.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Se nós crescemos, nossos Qivers também vem com a gente! Temos um Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 avançados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade e Privacidade

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive. Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir. Acreditamos que mudar o jogo depende de todos, independentemente de crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais
Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga e dados que possam ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. Não teremos acesso a dados fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade é identificação, comunicação e análise das candidatas.

Informamos que gerimos as vagas pelo sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas onde as vagas são espelhadas. Caso se candidate por meio de outro canal, leia os termos de cada plataforma. Em dúvidas, entre em contato pelo e-mail indicado na Política de Privacidade.

About InPlanet


InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany, Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.


Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.


Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symoo illustrates our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.


We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.


You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.


Check out our Culture page here.


Key Responsibilities



  • Providing accurate quantitative information for drawing up contracts with partner farmers, and logistical solutions to optimize the delivery of remineralizer.

  • Manage and process primary and secondary spatial data to produce dynamic and static maps and reports of high technical quality that communicate our operations and results effectively to various target audiences.

  • Undertaking multi-criteria analysis to guide decision-making in different stages of ERW project implementation.

  • Provide data to guide field campaigns, as well as constantly updating monitoring metrics from the data collected from sampling, transport and spreading.

  • Produce detailed technical documentation of the processes and methodologies used, supporting the project reporting and our carbon team by contributing to our project design documents (PDDs).

  • Maximizing the partner farmer's benefits through precision agriculture solutions that promote more efficient use of inputs and increased agricultural productivity, mainly through the mapping of physical and chemical soil properties.


Living Our Values


At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.



  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes

  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency

  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change


You can be a Rock-Star if you have


Core Skills & Experience



  • Academic background in areas related to Geosciences, Agricultural Sciences and the Environment, such as Geography, Cartographic Engineering, Agronomic Engineering, Forestry Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Management, Environmental Sciences, etc.

  • Core proficiency in QGIS.

  • Experience in an object-oriented programming language such as R and/or Python.

  • Basic understanding of Spatial SQL and DBMS like PostgreSQL & PostGIS.

  • Experience with Digital Image Processing techniques applied to optical and elevation data.

  • Data wrangling skills and familiarity with processing large datasets are a plus.

  • Experience with Spatial Sampling and Geostatistics is a plus.

  • Willingness to keep up‑to‑date and share knowledge about the latest geotechnologies trends, tools, and methods, especially related to the development of Free and Open Source Software for Geospatial (FOSS4G).

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Intrinsic motivation for personal and professional improvement.

  • High dedication, precision and love for detail.

  • Passion for sustainability, climate change mitigation, and technology‑driven solutions for positive impact.

  • Startup Drive: ability and excitement to work in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven, value‑driven environment.


Key Qualities



  • Strong communication skills, both in interpreting and presenting map data.

  • Proactive problem-solver with a desire for continuous learning and development.

  • Deep appreciation for nature and alignment with our purpose‑driven mission.


Bonus Points (but not essential)



  • A portfolio showcasing map quality and complexity.

  • Experience in soil sciences or related environmental fields.


Benefits



  • Competitive Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly

  • Home Office Budget

  • Personal development budget

  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance

  • 40 days annual leave

  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.

  • Offsites in Brazil yay!

  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4-hour time zones).


About the Role


We are seeking a passionate GIS Assistant to join our team, focusing on cartography, spatial analysis, and enhanced rock weathering projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in geoprocessing, remote sensing, and environmental management. This role is perfect for someone who loves nature, is aligned with our mission, and is eager to grow and stay updated with the latest geotechnology trends. If you're passionate about nature, GIS technologies, and environmental impact, we'd love to hear from you!


Core working relationships: You will report directly to Igor, the GIS Modeller. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with field technicians and project managers to ensure the successful integration of GIS data across various projects. Additionally, you will support the Science and Carbon teams by providing spatial data analysis and insights essential for our Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) operations.


InPlanet Compensation Philosophy


At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Overview

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

title: IT Operations Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the IT Operations Analyst role at BotCity .

Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.

We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.

We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you’re looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we’d love for you to join us on this journey.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and good communication.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g. deeper system issues).

Required Qualifications

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g. Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese – Fluent.
  • English – Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies.

Job Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
  • Employment type: Full‑time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Computer and Network Security

title: Ux Designer
description:
Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades.

We're looking for a UX Designer who's excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative, especially in games inspired by classic and modern JRPGs. As a UX Designer on our team, you'll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat and exploration.

We're not just looking for someone to make interfaces clean and usable, we want someone who can envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience.

You’ll collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player-first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game genre-aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player-first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain your reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply:

Send your e‑mail to "******" with a subject like "UX Designer – Your Name". Include your resume, portfolio, and any details about yourself that you'd like to share.

About Memory Ware: Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, born on **** to sustainably create video games designed with a player‑first philosophy, crafting compelling stories and experiences that create lasting, core memories for players. We are a self‑funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. If you're eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you'll feel right at home with us.

title: Ux Designer
description:
Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware .

Overview

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades. Our games are inspired by classic and modern JRPGs, blending combat, exploration, and narrative. As a UX Designer on our team, you'll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment‑to‑moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player‑first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game‑genre‑aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low‑fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine, ideally Unity.
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player‑first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system‑heavy or narrative‑rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing for console or controller‑first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

How to Apply

Send your e‑mail to "******" with a subject like "UX Designer- Your Name". Include your resume and portfolio and feel free to share any details about yourself that you'd like to share.

About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio founded in ****, committed to creating player‑first video games that craft compelling stories and lasting experiences. We are self‑funded and early in a new JRPG project.

title: Insurance Strategy Lead
description:
Overview

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first. Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a legacy of innovation, evolving from skilled nursing and hospitals to one of the largest health benefits providers in the US. At the core of this evolution is Humana’s Insurance Segment, which provides Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and other health plans to millions. By integrating insurance with care delivery through CenterWell, Humana is improving healthcare access, coordination, and affordability for its members.

Humana’s Insurance Segment Strategy team plays a pivotal role in defining the future of Humana’s Medicare and Medicaid businesses, which generate the majority of the company’s total revenue and earnings. Comprised of experienced professionals from top-tier consulting firms and leading healthcare organizations, the team works closely with senior leaders across the enterprise to drive high-profile strategy projects that address the business’s most complex challenges and biggest opportunities.

Humana is seeking an experienced team member with meaningful strategy consulting or healthcare strategy experience to join this team. As an Insurance Strategy Lead, you will directly contribute to high-impact strategy projects, engage with executive leadership, and develop actionable recommendations that shape Humana’s long-term direction. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where your insights will help inform Board-level discussions and enterprise-wide strategic priorities.

As a Lead, you will be responsible for deconstructing complex business challenges, conducting targeted research and analysis, and developing sound, data-driven recommendations that help guide Humana’s strategic direction. Your role will be instrumental in synthesizing strategic choices being made across the business unit into cohesive, actionable plans that drive both growth and profitability while improving the health of Humana’s members. You will also help shape implementation considerations and work closely with business owners to transition strategies into execution, ensuring that recommendations translate into meaningful business impact.

Recent example projects include development of a 5-year growth strategy for Humana’s Insurance business, developing a refreshed membership acquisition strategy, identifying key go-to-market priorities, assessing the performance of strategic initiatives and business areas, evolving key facets of the Medicare Advantage growth strategy, and identifying improvement opportunities for a key business function.

The product owner is responsible for the ownership and managing of the backlog for their assigned value stream(s), contributes to the product roadmap, understands customer and market needs for the CommandCentral RMS products. This position will be responsible for filling the agile product owner role for the CommandCentral RMS products. In this role, the product owner champions the need of the user, customer, and other stakeholders throughout the development process to ensure that what is delivered meets the goals, objectives, and desired outcomes of the project. To be successful, one must manage multiple projects simultaneously, at various stages of their development, from idea to completed feature.

  • Polished presentation skills for internal and external audiences

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a diverse team spread across multiple continents in a fast-moving environment

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Overview

Em primeiro lugar, queremos te contar um pouco mais sobre quem somos. Vamos lá? Muito prazer, nós somos a Aurum! Somos uma empresa consolidada no mercado de softwares jurídicos. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais inovadoras para uma nova forma de advogar. Nosso trabalho ajuda milhares de pessoas advogadas a gerenciarem melhor suas tarefas e aumentarem sua produtividade no dia a dia. Quer saber um segredo? Nós só conseguimos fazer tudo isso porque temos as melhores pessoas aqui. E como chamamos essa galera? #PessoasÁureas. Hoje somos mais de 200 pessoas espalhadas em todo o Brasil e também contamos com o apoio dos nossos escritórios em Florianópolis (SC) e São Paulo (SP). Não importa onde estamos, a nossa cultura é a mesma, sempre guiada pelos nossos valores. Aliás, com o apoio de pessoas tão incríveis, valores fortes e uma cultura massa, a gente já conquistou 10 vezes o selo do Great Place to Work e em 2024 ficamos bem posicionados em todos os três rankings que participamos. E sabe o que buscamos nas pessoas que vão se juntar ao nossO Time? Estamos em busca de profissionais que valorizem autonomia, responsabilidade, trabalho em time, aprendizado constante, colaboração, comunicação, e claro, proximidade e transparência! Se você se identifica com esse tipo de ambiente, já estamos começando a dar match! Consideramos única e especial cada pessoa do nosso time, por isso todas são bem vindas, temos um ambiente seguro para os áureos e áureas se expressarem do jeito que são. Dentro do time de Marketing sua missão será: atuar como um ponto de conexão estratégico entre Marketing, Branding e Produto. Você irá traduzir a proposta de valor dos nossos produtos e da marca Aurum em mensagens que geram conversão, retenção e fortalecimento de marca, garantindo que cada texto reforce nosso posicionamento e mova o usuário em sua jornada. Se você tem paixão por contar histórias, habilidade para defender suas ideias e um olhar analítico para otimizar resultados, esta vaga é para você! O modelo de trabalho é 100% Remoto!

Responsibilities

Observação: mantenha o foco em responsabilidades e resultados esperados. Abaixo estão as principais responsabilidades da vaga.

  • Desenvolver o conceito criativo de campanhas de marketing, alinhadas ao propósito da marca e aos objetivos de negócio (awareness, geração de leads, etc.).
  • Traduzir insights de pesquisa e planejamento em execuções criativas e inovadoras.
  • Estruturar e apresentar ideias de forma clara e convincente, defendendo o racional criativo por trás das propostas.
  • Planejar, junto do time, os desdobramentos e pautas de conteúdo a partir das campanhas principais para os diversos canais.
  • Escrever textos persuasivos (copywriting) para diferentes formatos e objetivos, como landing pages, anúncios de mídia on e offline, e-mails e trilhas de engajamento.
  • Criar roteiros para vídeos.
  • Desenvolver textos focados na experiência do usuário para o site da Aurum (UX Writing).
  • Atuar como guardiã do tom de voz da marca Aurum e dos produtos Astrea e Themis, garantindo coerência entre as frentes de marca, produto e iniciativas (eventos, portal, etc.).
  • Revisar conceitualmente e textualmente materiais produzidos por outras áreas.
  • Garantir o alinhamento das campanhas com os times de Marketing, Comercial e Atendimento, facilitando a comunicação e a execução integrada.
  • Participar ativamente da produção das peças e campanhas, assegurando a fidelidade à ideia original.
  • Utilizar a criatividade e a análise de dados para embasar a tomada de decisões e otimizar a performance das peças e conteúdos.
  • Acompanhar métricas de sucesso das entregas, como geração de trials, CTR (Click-Through Rate), taxas de conversão e posicionamento de marca.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Comunicação, Publicidade, Jornalismo, Letras ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência prévia na função de Copywriter ou redação publicitária.
  • Portfólio com projetos que demonstrem sua versatilidade na escrita para diferentes canais.
  • Domínio de técnicas de copywriting, storytelling e redação para o ambiente digital. Capacidade de desdobrar um conceito criativo em diferentes formatos de texto.
  • Habilidade para transformar briefings e estratégias em conceitos e textos criativos.
  • Habilidade para não apenas criar, mas também defender o racional criativo das ideias. Experiência em manter e aplicar a consistência do tom de voz de uma marca.
  • Boa comunicação e experiência no trabalho com times multidisciplinares
  • Perfil analítico, com habilidade para interpretar métricas de marketing (CTR, conversão) e usar dados para otimizar os textos

É um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia (SaaS B2B).
  • Conhecimentos em SEO aplicado a conteúdo.
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em UX Writing.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Figma e Google Analytics.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Informações adicionais

title: Ux Designer
description:
Overview

Ux Designer role at Memory Ware. Memory Ware is a fully remote studio focused on player-first experiences in games, with a JRPG-inspired design ethos.

We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a UX Designer who is excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative. You’ll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat and exploration. You should be able to envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience. You will collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

Responsibilities

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) are intuitive, satisfying, and player-first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the gameplay loop and propose smart, game-genre-aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure visual and technical execution supports usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low-fidelity prototypes.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player-first mindset with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy and ability to engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply

Email your resume and portfolio; include any details about yourself you’d like to share. Send your email to the address provided with a subject like "UX Designer- Your Name".

About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, focused on sustainably creating video games with a player-first philosophy, crafting stories and experiences that create lasting memories for players. We are a self-funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. If you’re eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you’ll feel right at home with us.

Location & Type

Joinville, Santa Catarina, Brazil — Full-time, Remote-friendly role. Seniority: Mid-Senior level.

HealthLinkNow, a division of Universal Health Services, Inc. (UHS), is actively seeking an experienced and compassionate Licensed Telehealth Therapist to join our expanding team of behavioral health professionals. HealthLinkNow (HLN) is a nationally recognized leader in telebehavioral health and the first telehealth company to earn Joint Commission accreditation. As part of Universal Health Services (UHS) – one of the nation’s largest and most respected healthcare organizations – we’re committed to delivering accessible, outcome‑driven mental health care across the country. With a 98% patient satisfaction rate, HLN’s innovative digital platform simplifies clinical workflows so you can focus on what matters most: your patients, your practice, and your growth.

Position Summary

As a Lead Telehealth Therapist, you will:

  • Deliver individual, family, and group therapy sessions through a secure telehealth platform.

  • Provide clinical leadership and mentorship while shaping program development and service delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual and group psychotherapy for clients with mental health and co‑occurring substance use disorders.
  • Facilitate and document IOP groups via telehealth.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.
  • Monitor and document progress using HLN’s EMR system.
  • Collaborate with psychiatrists and interdisciplinary teams to coordinate care.
  • Lead monthly clinical team meetings and contribute to provider evaluations.
  • Offer clinical oversight and mentorship as directed by leadership.
  • Participate in ongoing supervision, licensure support, and cross‑program initiatives.
  • Uphold ethical standards, organizational policies, and service excellence.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $90,000 – $93,000 (W‑2)

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and more
  • Work Environment: 100% remote — flexible scheduling with secure internet connection required
  • Team Support: Weekly peer supervision, Clinical Director guidance, and collaborative culture
  • Low Administrative Burden: Focus on client care — not paperwork
  • Work–Life Balance: Flexibility, autonomy, and strong organizational support
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities to lead initiatives, expand licensure, and shape program delivery

Why Join HealthLinkNow?

  • Be part of a mission‑driven, inclusive team expanding access to behavioral health services nationwide.
  • Enjoy career growth through leadership, training, and cross‑functional initiatives.
  • Benefit from flexible schedules, full benefits, and diverse assignments that keep your work engaging and meaningful.
  • Backed by Universal Health Services (UHS) — a Fortune 500 company with over 90,000 employees across 37 states and abroad.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, tech‑forward environment that supports your professional ambitions and personal well‑being.

Vision | Mission | Goals

Vision: To be the telehealth partner of choice for behavioral health.
Mission: To deliver outcome‑driven virtual behavioral healthcare that inspires hope and advocates for our patients and employees.
Goals: Clinical Excellence | Engaged Workforce | Customer Centricity

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role: We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host’pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English. As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!

Nosso time de Design de Produto tem papel fundamental na construção dos produtos no Asaas e o seu desafio será participar de todas as etapas de concepção do produto, desde a pesquisa até a finalização da interface, garantindo uma experiência de usuário incrível. Buscamos uma pessoa com autonomia para identificar e implantar alternativas de melhorias, além de acompanhar, planejar, modificar e executar procedimentos. Procuramos profissionais criativos, que tragam a paixão pelo design, experiência do usuário e a habilidade de solucionar problemas.

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville/SC? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

Responsabilidades

  • Dominar metodologias e boas práticas de experiência do usuário e interface
  • Vivência no setor de serviços financeiros
  • Criar soluções de produto que proporcionem uma jornada clara e compreensível para o nosso cliente
  • Ter pleno conhecimento das etapas de concepção do produto, desde a descoberta até a criação da interface
  • Garantir a entrega de alta qualidade ao documentar cuidadosamente a experiência do usuário e os requisitos de negócio
  • Aplicar pensamento crítico aos processos e boas práticas de usabilidade para transformar problemas complexos em experiências de uso incríveis
  • Utilizar métodos de validações das entregas através de testes de usabilidade e provas de conceito
  • Colaborar com o time de Produto e Engenharia para entregar as funcionalidades e requisitos solicitados pelos clientes stakeholders
  • Conhecimento sobre metodologias de testes como teste A/B
  • Vivência no setor de serviços financeiros
  • Atuação em soluções de pagamento de vendas físicas (Tap on phone e Maquininha)
  • Experiência com Service Design
  • Domínio de técnicas e aplicação de pesquisas quantitativas e qualitativas
  • Ter habilidade de facilitação e colaboração em equipe
  • Saber trabalhar de maneira autônoma
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar informações de maneira clara e concisa para diferentes públicos
  • Apresentar habilidade de resolução de problemas e abertura ao aprendizado
  • Domínio de prototipação rápida e desenvolvimento de protótipos interativos
  • Domínio sobre métodos de escalabilidade do design com o style guides e Design System
  • Ter atenção aos detalhes das regras de negócio durante a concepção das soluções
  • Ter atuado em empresa de adquirência ou subadquirência
  • Atuação em soluções de pagamento de vendas físicas

Benefícios e cultura

Somos uma super Fintech, Instituição de Pagamento credenciada pelo Banco Central do Brasil e temos como propósito maximizar a produtividade das empresas através da tecnologia. Oferecemos uma solução completa para gestão de cobranças, pagamentos, antecipações de recebíveis e atendemos mais de 200 mil clientes divididos entre profissionais autônomos, microempreendedores individuais (MEI) e grandes empresas.

Nosso sonho começou em 2010, em Joinville/SC e acreditamos que o céu não é o limite para o nosso crescimento. Não é à toa que atualmente nosso time está em vários cantos do Brasil! Mais de 800 pessoas sonham junto com o Asaas, de forma colaborativa, inovadora, eficiente, com autonomia e liberdade para voar alto.

Voos altos exigem recursos para viver e trabalhar melhor, além de liberdade para administrá-los da melhor forma. Por isso, acolhemos e cuidamos do nosso time oferecendo benefícios que apoiam seu crescimento pessoal e profissional:

Para saúde e bem-estar: temos assistência médica e odontológica sem coparticipação, seguro de vida, auxílio para compra de medicamentos e para realizar atividades físicas. Além disso, a Neon é nossa parceira para cuidar da saúde financeira do time e a Zenklub para a saúde física e mental (oferecemos 4 sessões mensais de terapia ou nutricionista gratuitas). Na sede, também temos quick massage.

Para alimentação e família: nosso benefício alimentação é flexível, por meio de um cartão de crédito, bandeira Visa. O saldo pode ser usado como cada um desejar. Na sede, temos free food e, para as famílias, oferecemos auxílio creche, programa de apoio parental e licença maternidade e paternidade estendida.

Para educação e crescimento: além de um ambiente de desafios e muito desenvolvimento, temos uma plataforma de treinamentos in company e disponibilizamos auxílio educação que subsidia 70% de mensalidades de graduações e idiomas, bem como a compra de cursos e livros, para que nosso time nunca pare de aprender.

Para o trabalho remoto de qualidade: oferecemos auxílio Home Office, equipamentos de trabalho, auxílio mobília e temos parceria com a WOBA, para os nossos colaboradores usarem coworkings em todo o Brasil quando desejarem.Conheça nossa sede, em Joinville/SC, nesse tour virtual!

Extras, porque o Dream Team merece: temos Day Off no mês do aniversário, auxílio Happy Hour, bonificação por indicação de novos colaboradores, bonificação baseada em metas anuais, plano de Stock Option s e um ambiente leve, no dress code!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‑based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security‑first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and also about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud‑first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, and be adaptable to the ever‑changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will be a highly motivated, dependable and experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution‑oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

This role will report to the Director of IT. You will be customer‑facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You will detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You are comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You will set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, NetSuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Integrating SSO into Okta, creating workflows in Okta, working with APIs, and integrating one system to another.
  • Remote support to people in multiple countries across time zones, familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media — clear ideas, helping people who might be frustrated or time‑poor.
  • Strong writing: tickets, email, Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, and concise writing, sensitive to different cultures.
  • Desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • Security mindset: PGP, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching), OSI troubleshooting.
  • Self‑management, scope projects, prioritize across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task‑management skills, comfortable dealing with ambiguity.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience using tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces for automation.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We are looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: passion for progress, builder’s mindset, collaborative partner, integrity and accountability, remote‑friendly comfort, ambiguity resilience, and remote experience.

Benefits and Compensation

As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. A comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package starts on your first day. Competitive PTO, ownership and shared equity, flexible remote work up to 180 days worldwide.

title: Computer Vision Engineer - R&D
description:
Senior Computer Vision Engineer

Panoptyc is seeking an exceptional Senior Computer Vision Engineer to architect and train cutting‑edge models for retail object recognition and drive our edge deployment strategy.

About The Role

You’ll be the technical force behind our computer vision capabilities, building and optimizing models that power real-world retail applications. This role demands someone who can move seamlessly from training custom YOLO architectures to deploying optimized models on edge devices, all while pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in retail computer vision.

What You’ll Do

  • Model Development: Design, train, and iterate on custom object detection models specifically tuned for retail environments, inventory tracking, and product recognition.
  • Edge Optimization: Take state‑of‑the‑art models and make them blazingly fast for edge deployment through quantization, pruning, and architectural optimization.
  • Dataset Engineering: Build robust data pipelines and annotation workflows to continuously improve model performance on diverse retail scenarios.
  • Research & Innovation: Stay ahead of the curve on CV research, prototype new architectures, and determine what’s actually production‑ready versus academic noise.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers, establish best practices for model development, and drive technical decisions around our CV infrastructure.
  • LLM Integration: Explore and implement multimodal approaches combining vision and language models for enhanced product understanding and classification.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of hands‑on computer vision engineering, with a proven track record of shipping models to production.
  • Deep expertise with YOLO and YOLO‑E architectures – you’ve trained them, tuned them, and know their quirks intimately.
  • Edge deployment mastery – experience with TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or similar frameworks for optimizing models for constrained devices.
  • LLM and LLMOps experience – practical knowledge of large language models, fine‑tuning, prompt engineering, and building reliable LLM‑powered systems.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals – clean code, version control, CI/CD for ML, and the ability to build maintainable systems.
  • Production ML experience – you understand the difference between a Jupyter notebook and a production‑grade ML system.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with retail, inventory management, or similar product‑focused CV applications.
  • Background with PyTorch and modern training frameworks.
  • Familiarity with synthetic data generation and data augmentation techniques.
  • Knowledge of model versioning, experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases, etc.).
  • Publications or open‑source contributions in computer vision.
  • Experience with AWS solutions like EC2, ECS, Fargate, S3, Bedrock, SageMaker, etc.

Technical Stack

While we value expertise over specific tools, you’ll likely work with: PyTorch, YOLO variants, TensorRT, ONNX, Docker, Kubernetes, and various MLOps tooling.

Location: Remote

Compensation: up to $60/hr USD (based on location)

Panoptyc is building the future of retail intelligence. If you’re ready to tackle hard CV problems at scale, we want to hear from you.
